title: DIP argument and manual-alignment review

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Bind current manual and assignment before treating preserved conventions as requirements; report exact native-source gaps.
Trace Chapter I through-line and construct/measure fit from cited text; literature grouping and cause claims need source evidence.
Keep possible root causes provisional; assessment may confirm, revise or overturn them.
Separate assessment, indicator, measurement and outcomes; pair manual and literature terms consistently after current manual verification.
Reconcile historical scope-formula conflict against advisor guide; do not impose it or invent current grading authority.

success_checks: Every observation links an exact paper location and applicable manual/research evidence or is labeled provisional.
Leadership readers receive defined terms and visible distinctions between contextual suggestion and assessment findings.
No numerical grade or current-manual compliance claim is made with unresolved native sources.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
